product_overview: Oilseed Hedging Platform is a comprehensive, real-time mobile application designed for Indian oilseed farmers, traders, and buyers to manage price risk, optimize trading strategies, and access transparent contract management through AI-powered insights and blockchain technology. It integrates futures and options trading, AI-driven decision support, marketplace features, and financial literacy tools aimed at reducing price volatility impact and enhancing market efficiency.
core_goals: Provide real-time NCDEX futures, spot, and options market data with frequent updates for accurate price tracking.
Enable users to perform advanced trading and hedging, with AI recommendations and portfolio risk management tools.
Offer a blockchain-secured forward contract system for transparent, enforceable agreements with digital signatures.
Deliver AI-powered decision support including price predictions, HOLX™ risk scoring, and personalized trading recommendations.
Create a marketplace for farmer-buyer direct interaction with multimedia listings and real-time updates.
Provide accessible learning modules to enhance financial literacy and empower farmers with market knowledge.
Support Farmer Producer Organization (FPO) integration for collective bargaining and group trading benefits.
Facilitate risk-free simulation mode for practice trading to build confidence without real monetary risk.
Deliver real-time notifications and feedback channels to enhance user engagement and platform responsiveness.
key_features: Dashboard with real-time market overview including live price tickers, portfolio summaries, and AI insights.
Market screen offering live NCDEX futures contracts, interactive candlestick charts, and a dual options marketplace for PUT (farmers) and CALL (buyers) options.
Hedging screen with an advanced calculator, AI-backed optimal hedge ratio suggestions, and hedge effectiveness monitoring.
Forward Contract management leveraging blockchain for immutable records, digital signatures, and settlement tracking with real-time notifications.
Comprehensive Wallet for multi-currency balance tracking, margin management, and transaction history.
AutoHedge system enabling automated hedging strategies tailored to user risk tolerance and market conditions.
Marketplace for listing and managing oilseed product sales with rich multimedia support (photos/videos) and real-time updates.
Education module featuring 8 financial literacy modules with video lessons, simulations, quizzes, progress tracking, and certificates.
Simulation Mode allowing users to trade with virtual funds replicating real market data to hone trading skills without financial risk.
FPO Integration to facilitate membership management, collective bargaining, price comparison, and group trading features.
Community features for farmers including posts and discussions for knowledge and experience sharing.
Agricultural insurance offerings with policy listings and application workflows.
Decision Support System (DSS) presenting actionable market insights and HOLX™ risk scores.
Real-time notifications via WebSocket for prices, settlements, contract updates, and user alerts.
Secure authentication using JWT and robust backend architecture using Node.js, PostgreSQL, and WebSocket services.
user_flow_summary: User registers or logs in via secure JWT authentication and selects user role (farmer/buyer/trader).
On the Dashboard, user accesses live market data, AI insights, and marketplace listings personalized by role and location.
User navigates to Market screen to view and trade NCDEX futures or engage in options market (PUT for farmers, CALL for buyers) with AI price predictions.
In Hedging screen, user calculates optimal hedge positions via AI calculator and executes hedging strategies with one-click actions.
User manages forward contracts by creating new contracts, accessing AI price suggestions, digitally signing, and tracking settlements with real-time blockchain-verified updates.
Marketplace allows creation and browsing of listings with multimedia uploads and live update subscriptions to engage buyers and sellers effectively.
Users may enroll in AutoHedge for automated risk management and monitor performance through dedicated screens.
Education module provides structured learning with interactive content that tracks progress and awards certificates upon completion.
Simulation Mode offers a virtual trading environment mimicking real market conditions for skill development without financial consequence.
FPO Integration supports membership management and group trading activities, enhancing collective bargaining power.
Community features enable posting, discussion, and feedback submission fostering collaboration and continuous improvement.
Notifications deliver timely alerts on market events, contract statuses, and platform updates maintaining user engagement.
validation_criteria: Real-time market price data updates conform to expected 3-second intervals with low latency (<100ms).
Trading and hedging functionalities provide accurate calculations, AI recommendations match market conditions and user risk profiles.
Forward contracts are recorded immutably on blockchain, with transaction hashes logged and visible in the app.
Digital signature workflows operate smoothly with user confirmation prompts and settlement requests triggering WebSocket notifications appropriately.
Marketplace listings support multimedia uploads with image/video validation, real-time display, and low latency updates.
Educational modules record user progress accurately and produce certificates upon completion.
AutoHedge system triggers trades based on user-defined parameters and logs performance metrics precisely.
User authentication processes secure login, registration, and session management with JWT and password hash validation.
Simulation Mode transactions mirror real market data and update virtual account balances correctly.
API endpoints conform to documented routes, handle errors gracefully, and enforce JWT authentication for protected resources.
WebSocket broadcasts price updates, contract settlements, and notifications reliably without data loss.
System scalability and performance targets met with 99.9% uptime, response times under 200ms for API and sub 100ms for WebSocket.
Comprehensive security practices observed including data encryption, SQL injection prevention, and blockchain contract safety features.
User feedback system collects, stores, and presents feedback effectively for product improvement.
Multilingual support operational with English and Hindi interfaces throughout the mobile app.
